findings.title: Validate HTML inside ChoiceFormat branches instead of discarding it
findings.body: This replacement removes the entire ChoiceFormat expression before checking HTML, including all branch text. For example, a translated linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit.minutes value of `{0,choice,0#minutes|1#minute|1

findings.title: Keep React validation messages in i18next format
findings.body: This frontend resource uses i18next interpolation with double-braced arguments such as `{{0}}`, not Java MessageFormat syntax. Replacing those arguments with `{0}` and adding `{2,choice,...}` leaves unevaluated formatting text in multivalued-size validation errors instead of the field name and limits. The admin UI resource has the same change. Keep both React resources in frontend-supported interpolation/pluralization syntax; Java ChoiceFormat belongs in the server-side bundles.

findings.title: Prevent overlapping prefix and suffix trimming
findings.body: The suffix loop can consume characters already counted by the prefix loop. With an English message containing bold markup, a translation `` sanitizes to ``. The common prefix has length 4 and the common suffix length 5, so the diagnostic calls `sanitized.substring(4, 2)` and throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. This aborts verification rather than returning the illegal-HTML diagnostic. Bound suffix trimming by the remaining length after the prefix.

findings.title: Translate the OTP setup instruction into Lithuanian
findings.body: The replacement `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` is Italian, but this is the Lithuanian message bundle. Lithuanian users now receive an Italian instruction during OTP setup. The same sentence was also introduced for totpStep1 in the Lithuanian account bundle. Both replacements should use Lithuanian text.
